Tune in to 9to5Mac for your daily curated news roundup. 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes, Apple Podcasts, Stitcher, TuneIn, Google Play, and Overcast, as well as dedicated RSS feeds for other podcast players.

Sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you get everything out of your head and into one simple, elegant system — closing those open loops and easing the mental load. It's an easy-to-use to-do list app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, packed with powerful tools to make organising, tracking, and ticking off tasks deeply satisfying. Get Stuff done.

New episodes of 9to5Mac Daily are recorded every weekday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast player to make sure new episodes are delivered straight to your ears the moment they're released.

The news discussed in this episode:

  • watchOS 27.2 beta 2 brings back the App Switcher with a new gesture
  • Report says Apple is developing a screenless fitness tracker similar to Whoop
  • What exactly is GM's CarPlay strategy (or lack thereof)?
  • Apple ends the unique AR experience at the Apple Park Visitor Center
